svg.title: Shakunetsu Sakura — Dragon of Falling Petals. Draft 2 / Scorch classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Ember Dragon's Roots forks into Kindled Boughs then Dragon in Full Blossom, or Branded by Petals then Scorching Hanami. Falling Ember Petals forks into Burning Petal Carpet then Conflagration in Bloom, or Smothering Petal Rain then Deluge of Burning Petals. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Scorch jutsu.

The two A-rank Hiru-Sakura circles carry the only Damage rows (Sakuragari 40 and Sakura-ame 50 EP at jutsu level 25, one hit on every user inside the radius-1 area) and are the declared primary; the kit's Damage Over Time trait lives on Dancing Embers' unsupported wound. Increase Damage Taken is the broadest tag by reach (two 35% rows on the Sakuragari circle and the Sakura Dragon Tree, all four stat types and no element, so every non-pierce hit on the exposed target is amplified), and the D-rank 40 AP Sakura Dragon Tree also carries the kit's single 35% self Increase Damage Given (Fire, None, Scorch, Wind) on top of the bloodline's same-element passive, so those two share the secondary. Decrease Damage Given (Sakura-ame 30%, enemies only) and the Sakura Dragon Pearl's static 25 Heal (250 HP per tick) are single rows. Ember Dragon's Roots (Pearl, Dragon Tree) forks into Kindled Boughs \u2192 Dragon in Full Blossom (Increase Damage Given) and Branded by Petals \u2192 Scorching Hanami (Increase Damage Taken). Falling Ember Petals (the two Hiru-Sakura circles) forks into Burning Petal Carpet \u2192 Conflagration in Bloom (Damage) and Smothering Petal Rain \u2192 Deluge of Burning Petals (Decrease Damage Given). 2F/4H/4A; every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP.","Routes: Amplifier +10% Increase Damage Given (Ember Dragon's Roots +2%, Kindled Boughs +3%, Dragon in Full Blossom +5%; 35 \u2192 45%); Burst +5 Damage (Burning Petal Carpet +2, Conflagration in Bloom +3); Suppression +10% Decrease Damage Given (Falling Ember Petals +2%, Smothering Petal Rain +3%, Deluge of Burning Petals +5%; 30 \u2192 40%); Exposure +5% Increase Damage Taken (Branded by Petals +2%, Scorching Hanami +3%), held to the 5 band because its two rows stack on one target (35 \u2192 40% each; on a target caught by both they compound, \u00d71.40 \u00d7 1.40 \u2248 \u00d71.96). Falling Ember Petals carries no Damage, so no allocation exceeds +5 Damage; Heal peaks at +5% (Roots +2%, Dragon in Full Blossom +3%; Pearl 25 \u2192 30, 300 HP a tick). Capstone secondaries under-bid the Hidden Art on their tag (Increase Damage Given +2% < Kindled Boughs +3%; Damage +1 < Burning Petal Carpet +2).","Interactions: the Dragon Tree buff row (Fire, None, Scorch, Wind) multiplies the Scorch circles, element-less hits (basic attacks, weapons) and Fire/Wind jutsu in its 2-round window; the bloodline's same-element Increase Damage Given passive (25 + 0.15/level) multiplies last. Both Increase Damage Taken rows list all four stat types and no element, so every hit on the exposed target, from the player, allies or weapons, is amplified. Pierce runs after the modifier pass and is neither raised nor amplified.","Delivery: every cast has cooldown 7. Sakuragari and Sakura-ame are 60 AP OTHER_USER AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN casts at range 4; per the batch-1 Aerathiel read, their INHERIT rows land once on every other living user in the radius-1 circle, with no ground effect: one Scorch hit and 2-round debuffs per user. The Dragon Tree is a 40 AP single-target cast at range 5 (legal target needed; self buff and enemy exposure together). The Pearl is a 40 AP self cast; its Heal ticks on following rounds.","Fourth purchases: Burst \u2192 Ember Dragon's Roots (buff 37%, Pearl 270 HP) or Smothering Petal Rain (suppression 35%); Exposure \u2192 Falling Ember Petals (suppression 32%) or Kindled Boughs (buff 42%); Amplifier \u2192 Branded by Petals (exposure 37%) or Falling Ember Petals (suppression 32%); Suppression \u2192 Burning Petal Carpet (circles 43 / 53 EP) or Ember Dragon's Roots (circles 41 / 51 EP). No-capstone hybrids: 01, 02, 04, 06 (buff 40%, exposure 37%) and 01, 06, 07, 09 (circles 42 / 52 EP, suppression 35%)."],"risks":["Classification: Scorch is the single qualifying element; sharing it with Taiyo Kami is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). 3 of 7 kit rows carry Scorch; the 4 element-less rows need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Sakura Dragon Pearl carries no Scorch row, so in-kit it qualifies only through an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Scorch coverage (NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN) is unverified.","Ally hazard: Sakuragari rows 0 (Damage) and 1 (exposure) and Sakura-ame row 0 (Damage) are AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN rows with no friendlyFire value (=ALL), so allies inside the radius-1 circle take the enhanced Scorch hit and exposure too; the caster is never a target (batch-1 read). Nodes 07, 08 and 10 (Damage) and 04 and 05 (Increase Damage Taken) raise that; positioning decides. Sakura-ame's suppression row is ENEMIES only.","Exposure stacking: the Sakuragari circle and the Dragon Tree each apply a separate 2-round Increase Damage Taken debuff and BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is on at the pin, so on a target caught by both the two rows compound: every non-pierce hit from the player, allies and weapons is multiplied by \u00d71.35 \u00d7 1.35 \u2248 \u00d71.82 at base and \u00d71.40 \u00d7 1.40 \u2248 \u00d71.96 at the +5% route maximum. The route is held to +5% and both exposure nodes sit on one branch for this reason; not simulated.","Increase Damage Given reach: the Sakura Dragon Tree self buff (Fire, None, Scorch, Wind) multiplies normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks in its window, not only kit casts, and the bloodline's same-element passive (about 29% at level 25) multiplies after it; 45% is far below the 100 cap.","Area delivery: the dossier footnote calls AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN rows re-applied ground effects reaching the caster; the batch-1 Aerathiel read found OTHER_USER circles apply INHERIT rows once, directly to users in the radius-1 area, with no ground effect and the caster excluded. This tree follows that read, unverified here; if the circles persist, the Damage route is worth more than stated.","Unsupported rows: Dancing Embers (pierce 60, wound 30%), the Pearl's debuffprevent, Sakuragari's self shield and the visual rows receive no bonus. Because pierce bypasses the damage-modifier pass, the Amplifier and Exposure routes do not raise the pierce hit and the Suppression route does not reduce enemy pierce; the kit's B-rank attack is outside every node.","Heal: the Pearl's Heal row is static (\u00d710 HP per tick) and applies on following rounds, so +5% Heal at the maximum is 300 HP per tick against 250; tick count per cast and healprevent were not simulated. Heal appears only on the dragon root (Foundation +2%, Dragon in Full Blossom +3%).","Damage rows are formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling) and then multiplied by the Scorch Increase Damage Given passive, so +5 Damage is not a linear +5. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Scorch jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Conflagration in Bloom path + Ember Dragon's Roots
Scorching Hanami path + Falling Ember Petals
Dragon in Full Blossom path + Branded by Petals
Deluge of Burning Petals path + Burning Petal Carpet
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHAKUNETSU SAKURA KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 2 / Scorch classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
